Hi Tom — thanks for the detail and the attachments. Quick note on timing: the US switches to DST on Sunday 14th March, which will shift Eastern by one hour relative to Europe. Practically, that means 19:00 ET on Mar 15 will be 00:00 (midnight) for most of our EU-based team (we're currently UTC+0).

We can staff that late slot, but want to make sure two things are clear: 1) the hands-on infra deep-dive might run into very late hours for some engineers, and 2) if you need executive-level follow-up in EU business hours, we should schedule a separate handoff.

Options:
- We cover 19:00 ET Mar 15 (we'll rotate people; Vivek can handle the infra deep-dive remotely).
- Move to 16:00 ET / 21:00 UTC (Mar 15) — earlier for us and still within your stated window.
- Split: 45-min public demo at 17:00 ET + optional 30-min deep-dive for infra recorded and followed up with a 1-hour live deep-dive during EU morning on Mar 16.

Please confirm which you prefer and whether procurement wants the security/compliance section first. Also looping in Vivek and Karthik to confirm staffing.

Best,
Grace
